title: The Moravian Graveyards at Nazareth, Pa., 1744–1904
summary: Originally published in 1906 within the Transactions of the Moravian Historical Society, this volume contains the names, gravesite locations, and available personal details for 1,201 people interred at the two original Moravian graveyards in Nazareth, Pennsylvania, between 1744 and 1904. A map of the primary graveyard and a comprehensive name index add to the volume’s accessibility as a guide for visits and research. This volume also includes a note on Moravian burial practices and a brief history of the graveyards in Nazareth.
